author: PeterSchiff
text: Investors are ignoring a 5.2% yield on 10-year Treasuries as it’s too low to compete with the high returns they expect to earn on stocks. Bond yields must rise until they’re high enough to compete. If that’s 10%, interest payments will soon consume 100% of federal tax revenue.
